methodology.scope: Materialized queries only; dedicated disposable PostgreSQL container and in-memory node:sqlite. One sequential process and physical connection per engine shared by all variants; no simultaneous operations.
methodology.baseline: Saved driver bundles only; baseline and current use the same current core/runtime dependencies resolved from tests/node_modules. This isolates driver extraction, not a whole-release comparison.
methodology.scheduling: Each case warms every variant, then rotates the first variant each round and reverses on odd rounds. Timed loops await every operation, including synchronous SQLite. Row checks run outside timing before warmup and after all rounds.
methodology.timing: Each sample is elapsed client wall time divided by operations in a fixed-duration batch. Native IO+materialization includes server execution, network, client protocol handling and materialization; these are NOT individually measurable here. Stage diagnostics are independent operations, not an additive decomposition of end-to-end latency.
methodology.semantics: All variants use positional native rows. PostgreSQL integer OIDs use lossless text parsing. SQLite reads bigint and prepares anew on every operation; no prepared cache. Native/extracted raw results retain positional rows and native metadata; normalized variants and all SQLBraid variants return named rows with exact integers as strings. Native raw timings are lower-semantic-work references, not equivalent SQLBraid replacements.
methodology.fixture: id, text label, >2^53 exact integer, and nullable text. Range reads of 1/100/10000 rows, indexed point lookup, and idempotent one-row UPDATE without RETURNING. No JSON/temporal/decimal/stream/prepare/bulk claims.
methodology.memory: heapDeltaBytes measures heapUsed after minus before each timed batch (explicit GC before batch when available). It is not allocated bytes or retained bytes; collection may make it negative. GC entries are observed process-wide pauses overlapping a sample, not attribution to a library or allocation counts. Explicit pre-sample GC lies outside the timing window.
methodology.acquisition: PostgreSQL acquisition diagnostics use one warmed dedicated pool, acquire+release with no SQL, separately from pinned-connection query cases. SQLite has no provider acquisition; opening/closing a database is deliberately not substituted.
methodology.bridge: Benchmark-local materialized QueryExecutor: public SQLBraid binding/rendering/runtime, real extracted Connection IO, public PostgreSQL TypePolicy decoding, and SQLite bigint-to-string projection. Unsupported hints/routines/streaming/cancellation are rejected, not emulated. Projection is fixture-focused and not a production adapter.

postgres.version: PostgreSQL 16.4 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 13.2.1_git20240309) 13.2.1 20240309, 64-bit
postgres.connection: single pinned client; pool acquisition measured separately
postgres.nativeDefaultInt4: number; timed variants explicitly use lossless text for policy parity

sqlite.acquisition: not applicable: node:sqlite has no provider/pool
